judge_anchors.canonical_stance: The deterministic ledger returns rain_runout_loss with a 24.33 point margin over the next score.
do_not_add: source material outside the local package
required_elements: Use all nine extracted package metrics.
Apply the capped component formulas before candidate scores; compute scores from unrounded components.
Report rain_runout_loss as the best label.
Keep the final statement tied to the numeric ledger.

expected_output.interpretation: The score ledger favors rain_runout_loss because rainfall, path, damage, and loss components all reach their caps while the context component is lower.

score_details.component_rounding_policy: Components are reported to three decimals, but candidate scores are computed from unrounded component values and then rounded to two decimals.

source_date_note.interpretation: The ledger uses the package precipitation/event anchor date for rainfall metrics and treats the HDX date as product/source metadata for damage/path evidence.

primary_gt.interpretation: The score ledger favors rain_runout_loss because rainfall, path, damage, and loss components all reach their caps while the context component is lower.

provenance.notes: Candidate scores are computed from unrounded component values and rounded only at the final score step. HDX/UNOSAT notes reference 15 August imagery/product metadata; precipitation and event metrics use the package's 14 August event anchor.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, components, candidate_scores, best_label, margin_to_second, and interpretation; best_label is rain_runout_loss.
criteria.name: Output label and JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right label with one missing field or minor naming drift.

criteria.description: Extracts the precipitation, path, damage, loss, forest, and population values from the local package.
criteria.name: Package value extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award credit value by value; small rounding differences are acceptable for continuous quantities.

criteria.description: Computes precip_pair, path, damage, loss, and context using the stated caps and weights.
criteria.name: Component formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each mostly correct component; reduce credit for missing caps or swapped weights.

criteria.description: Applies all four candidate formulas using unrounded component values, then rounds final candidate scores to two decimals.
criteria.name: Candidate score formulas
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct formulas with arithmetic or rounding errors in one or two candidates.

criteria.description: Identifies the second-best score as 75.0 and computes a 24.33 point margin.
criteria.name: Comparison arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct best label with an incorrect or missing margin.

criteria.description: Explains the result as a formula outcome from saturated rainfall, path, damage, and loss components, not as a broad narrative.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a concise statement that names the best label but omits the component reason.
